title: Washington Monument, Philadelpia, from Robert N. Dennis collection of stereoscopic views 3
blurb: Despite the NYPL having captioned this as being in Washington, D.C., User:Clindberg—in remarks originally made at User talk:Jmabel/Stereo cards of Washington, D.C.—identifies this as Rudolf Siemering's 1897 Washington Monument in Philadelphia. Photo of it here taken from the Art Museum steps: the road layout has apparently changed considerably around there since.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.15% vertical error and 0.04° of rotation. Depth measured moderate (1.76% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at full size.
collection_name: Robert N. Dennis Collection of Stereoscopic Views
